hook: Cyberabad societies offer *200 MLD* treated water for drinking water
hook_b: Cyberabad societies offer *200 MLD* treated water for drinking water
tldr: About 150 gated communities and hundreds of societies in Kondapur, Gachibowli, Tellapur, Kollur, Osman Sagar and the Financial District generate nearly 200 MLD of treated wastewater. They want HMWSSB to take the surplus for parks and construction and give drinking water or tanker rebates in return.

beats.what: Cyberabad societies proposed a water-for-water barter with HMWSSB.
beats.why: The city is in a water crisis while surplus treated water flows into drains.
beats.care: RWAs asked for tankers at Rs 400 instead of Rs 500 for communities that supply treated water.

effects.label: Parks and construction could use it
Residents seek drinking water in return

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: TOI (Nov 20): the Federation of Gated Communities Cyberabad wants the board to meet 25-30% of their drinking water shortfall in exchange.

cards.q: Should HMWSSB swap drinking water for societies' treated wastewater?

qs: Who would pay for pipelines to collect treated water from Tellapur and Kollur?
Would a swap change how much tanker water societies buy?

facts.t: One Puppalguda society of 2,700 flats makes *14 lakh litres* of treated water a day and reuses about 9 lakh.
Around 40 gated communities in Tellapur, Kollur and Osman Sagar discharge nearly *70%* of their treated water.

viz.verdict: Residents seek a ₹100 rebate per tanker; board has not decided
About half is reused; the surplus often goes to drains

watch: Officials say a water-for-water exchange model is likely to be discussed; the earlier incentive was Rs 25 per kilolitre.
